income.ts:
/** HQ-22 收益联查、提点分配、结算重算与冲正。字段对齐小程序 incomeEntry / allocation / income-detail；金额为整数分；公式与比例仅展示服务端回传，前端不算佣。 */
export type IncomeModule = 'wholesale' | 'costore' | 'agency'
export type IncomeChannel = 'B' | 'C' | 'SUPPLY' | 'GLOBAL_AWARD' | 'FOUNDER_AWARD'
export type AllocationStatus = 'PENDING' | 'ALLOCATED'
export type AllocationKind = 'sales' | 'inspection'
export type SettlementStatus =
  | 'PENDING_ALLOCATION'
  | 'PENDING_SETTLEMENT'
  | 'SETTLED'
  | 'RECALC_PENDING'
  | 'REVERSED'
export type IncomeEntryKind = 'ORIGINAL' | 'RECALC' | 'REVERSAL'

export interface IncomeEntry {
  entryId: string
  kind: IncomeEntryKind
  /** 冲正/重算关联的原流水；原单为 null */
  relatedEntryId: string | null
  sourceOrder: string
  title: string
  category: string
  channel: IncomeChannel
  module: IncomeModule
  identityLabel: string
  accountId: string
  accountName: string
  phone: string
  storeId: string | null
  storeName: string | null
  regionLabel: string | null
  /** 金额（分，可为负：冲正流水） */
  amount: number
  baseAmount: number
  /** 业务提点基点，仅展示，前端不得据此重算 */
  rateBps: number
  allocationStatus: AllocationStatus
  allocationKind: AllocationKind
  allocationTarget: string | null
  allocationAgentId: string | null
  beneficiaryName: string
  settlementStatus: SettlementStatus
  pendingNote: string | null
  createdAt: string
  settledAt: string | null
  version: number
  mockOnly: true
  allowedActions: ('reassign-allocation' | 'request-recalc' | 'request-reverse')[]
}

export interface IncomeAudit {
  operationId: string
  requestId: string
  action: IncomeMutation['action']
  targetId: string
  relatedEntryId: string | null
  before: string
  after: string
  reason: string
  operatorId: string
  operatorName: string
  occurredAt: string
  beforeVersion: number
  afterVersion: number
}

export interface IncomeQuery {
  page: number
  pageSize: number
  keyword?: string
  module?: IncomeModule
  channel?: IncomeChannel
  allocationStatus?: AllocationStatus
  settlementStatus?: SettlementStatus
  storeId?: string
  accountId?: string
}

export interface IncomeList {
  items: IncomeEntry[]
  total: number
  page: number
  pageSize: number
  summary: {
    entries: number
    pendingAllocation: number
    pendingSettlement: number
    settled: number
    recalcPending: number
    reversed: number
    /** 分 */
    settledAmount: number
    pendingAmount: number
  }
}

export interface IncomeCatalog {
  stores: { storeId: string; name: string }[]
  modules: { value: IncomeModule; label: string }[]
  channels: { value: IncomeChannel; label: string }[]
  allocationTargets: { value: string; label: string; kind: AllocationKind | 'both' }[]
  settlementStatuses: { value: SettlementStatus; label: string }[]
  engineGapNote: string
  audit: IncomeAudit[]
  mockOnly: true
}

export interface IncomeDetail {
  entry: IncomeEntry
  /** 关联流水（冲正/重算子单或指向的原单） */
  related: IncomeEntry[]
  audit: IncomeAudit[]
  engineGapNote: string
}

export type IncomeMutation =
  | {
      action: 'reassign-allocation'
      entryId: string
      version: number
      targetId: string
      agentId?: string
      reason: string
      idempotencyKey: string
    }
  | {
      action: 'request-recalc'
      entryId: string
      version: number
      reason: string
      idempotencyKey: string
    }
  | {
      action: 'request-reverse'
      entryId: string
      version: number
      reason: string
      idempotencyKey: string
    }

export type IncomeMutationResult =
  | { action: 'reassign-allocation'; entry: IncomeEntry; mockOnly: true }
  | { action: 'request-recalc'; entry: IncomeEntry; linked: IncomeEntry; mockOnly: true }
  | { action: 'request-reverse'; entry: IncomeEntry; linked: IncomeEntry; mockOnly: true }

export class IncomeError extends Error {
  constructor(
    public code: 'FORBIDDEN' | 'NOT_FOUND' | 'INVALID_INPUT' | 'INVALID_STATE' | 'VERSION_CONFLICT' | 'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT',
    message: string,
  ) {
    super(message)
    this.name = 'IncomeError'
  }
}

/** HQ-24 推广素材、二维码区域模板、视频互动 H5。对照 partner/materials、material-edit；总部维护模板与唯一二维码填充区；禁止前端伪造服务端合成终图；视频不烧录二维码。 */
export type PromoMaterialType = 'image' | 'article' | 'video'
export type PromoMaterialStatus = 'DRAFT' | 'PUBLISHED' | 'OFFLINE'
/** 视频仅互动 H5；不默认烧录二维码。 */

export type PromoMaterialAction = 'save' | 'set-qr-region' | 'publish' | 'offline' | 'delete'

/** 原图上唯一二维码填充区；归一化坐标 0–1，相对 mediaWidth/mediaHeight。 */
export interface QrFillRegion {
  x: number
  y: number
  width: number
  height: number
}

export interface PromoMaterialCategory {
  categoryId: string
  name: string
  type: PromoMaterialType
}

export interface PromoMaterialTemplate {
  materialId: string
  title: string
  type: PromoMaterialType
  categoryId: string
  categoryName: string
  status: PromoMaterialStatus
  coverUrl: string
  mediaUrl: string
  posterUrl: string | null
  summary: string
  /** 图片发布前必填；视频为 null（走 H5，不烧录）。 */
  qrRegion: QrFillRegion | null
  mediaWidth: number
  mediaHeight: number
  videoDeliveryMode: VideoDeliveryMode | null
  /** 专用 web-view/H5 路由就绪度；当前联调缺口为 false。 */
  h5RouteReady: boolean
  h5RouteNote: string
  shareUrlTemplate: string
  partnerOperations: PartnerMaterialOp[]
  /** 恒 true：合图仅服务端；前端不得展示/生成伪终图。 */

  version: number
  updatedAt: string
  publishedAt: string | null

  operationId: string
  requestId: string
  action: PromoMaterialAction
  targetId: string
  before: string
  after: string

  operatorName: string
  occurredAt: string
  beforeVersion: number
  afterVersion: number

export interface PromoMaterialQuery {
  page: number
  pageSize: number
  keyword?: string
  type?: PromoMaterialType
  status?: PromoMaterialStatus
  categoryId?: string
}

export interface PromoMaterialList {
  items: PromoMaterialTemplate[]
  total: number
  page: number
  pageSize: number
  summary: {
    templates: number
    draft: number
    published: number
    offline: number
    imageWithRegion: number
    videoH5: number
    missingQrRegion: number
  }
}

export interface PromoMaterialCatalog {
  categories: PromoMaterialCategory[]
  types: { id: PromoMaterialType; label: string }[]

  videoH5GapNote: string

    dedicatedWebViewRoutePending: true
    clientSideComposeForbidden: true
  }

}

export interface PromoMaterialDetail {
  template: PromoMaterialTemplate
  audit: PromoMaterialAudit[]
  composeGapNote: string
  videoH5GapNote: string
}

export type PromoMaterialMutation =
  | {
      action: 'save'
      materialId?: string
      version: number
      reason: string
      idempotencyKey: string
      title: string
      type: PromoMaterialType
      categoryId: string
      coverUrl: string
      mediaUrl: string
      posterUrl?: string | null
      summary: string
      mediaWidth: number
      mediaHeight: number
      shareUrlTemplate: string
    }
  | {
      action: 'set-qr-region'
      materialId: string
      version: number
      reason: string
      idempotencyKey: string
      qrRegion: QrFillRegion
    }
  | {
      action: 'publish' | 'offline' | 'delete'
      materialId: string
      version: number
      reason: string
      idempotencyKey: string

  action: PromoMaterialAction

export type PromoMaterialErrorCode =
  | 'FORBIDDEN'
  | 'NOT_FOUND'
  | 'INVALID_INPUT'
  | 'INVALID_STATE'
  | 'VERSION_CONFLICT'
  | 'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT'
  | 'QR_REGION_REQUIRED'
  | 'QR_REGION_INVALID'

export class PromoMaterialError extends Error {
  constructor(public code: PromoMaterialErrorCode, message: string) {
    super(message)
    this.name = 'PromoMaterialError'
  }
}

  kinds: { value: FeedbackKind; label: string }[]
  buckets: { value: LessonBucket; label: string }[]
  audit: TrainingAudit[]
  mockOnly: true
}

export interface TrainingMemberDetail {
  balance: TrainingMemberBalance
  consumes: LessonConsumeRecord[]
  feedback: TrainingFeedback[]
  audit: TrainingAudit[]
}

export type TrainingMutation =
  | {
      action: 'proxy-feedback'
      memberId: string
      kind: FeedbackKind
      title: string
      body: string
      reason: string
      idempotencyKey: string
    }
  | {
      action: 'withdraw-feedback'
      feedbackId: string
      version: number
      reason: string
      idempotencyKey: string
    }
  | {
      action: 'consume-lessons'
      memberId: string
      bucket: LessonBucket
      quantity: number
      version: number
      reason: string
      idempotencyKey: string
    }

export type TrainingMutationResult =
  | { action: 'proxy-feedback'; feedback: TrainingFeedback; mockOnly: true }
  | { action: 'withdraw-feedback'; feedback: TrainingFeedback; mockOnly: true }
  | { action: 'consume-lessons'; balance: TrainingMemberBalance; record: LessonConsumeRecord; mockOnly: true }

export class TrainingError extends Error {
  constructor(
    public code: 'FORBIDDEN' | 'NOT_FOUND' | 'INVALID_INPUT' | 'INVALID_STATE' | 'VERSION_CONFLICT' | 'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT',
    message: string,
  ) {
    super(message)
    this.name = 'TrainingError'
  }
}
withdrawals.ts:
/** HQ-23 提现审核、打款回执与凭证。字段对齐小程序 wallet/withdraw-* 与 BusinessWithdrawals；金额整数分；不伪造银行打款终态——仅登记回执。最低额/费率/自动打款待定。 */
export type WithdrawAccountType = 'PERSONAL' | 'COMPANY'
export type WithdrawStatus = 'PENDING_REVIEW' | 'PROCESSING' | 'SUCCEEDED' | 'REJECTED'
export type WithdrawModule = 'wholesale' | 'costore' | 'agency'
export type PayoutReceiptStatus = 'NONE' | 'SUCCESS' | 'FAILED'

export interface WithdrawalApplication {
  withdrawalId: string
  title: string
  module: WithdrawModule
  identityLabel: string
  accountId: string
  accountName: string
  phone: string
  /** 申请金额（分） */
  amount: number
  /** 手续费快照（分）；费率政策待定，仅展示申请时快照 */
  fee: number
  /** 预计到账（分） */
  netAmount: number
  accountType: WithdrawAccountType
  payeeName: string
  bankName: string
  maskedBankNumber: string
  status: WithdrawStatus
  payoutReceiptStatus: PayoutReceiptStatus
  payoutFailureReason: string | null
  voucherUrl: string | null
  rejectionReason: string | null
  /** 只读关联 HQ-22 已结算流水 id，不联动改余额 */
  relatedIncomeEntryIds: string[]
  createdAt: string
  reviewedAt: string | null
  receiptAt: string | null
  version: number
  mockOnly: true
  allowedActions: ('approve' | 'reject' | 'register-receipt')[]
}

export interface WithdrawalAudit {
  operationId: string
  requestId: string
  action: WithdrawalMutation['action']
  targetId: string
  before: string
  after: string
  reason: string
  operatorId: string
  operatorName: string
  occurredAt: string
  beforeVersion: number
  afterVersion: number
}

export interface WithdrawalQuery {
  page: number
  pageSize: number
  keyword?: string
  status?: WithdrawStatus
  module?: WithdrawModule
  accountType?: WithdrawAccountType
  accountId?: string
}

export interface WithdrawalList {
  items: WithdrawalApplication[]
  total: number
  page: number
  pageSize: number
  summary: {
    applications: number
    pendingReview: number
    processing: number
    succeeded: number
    rejected: number
    receiptFailed: number
    pendingAmount: number
    succeededAmount: number
  }
}

export interface WithdrawalCatalog {
  modules: { value: WithdrawModule; label: string }[]
  statuses: { value: WithdrawStatus; label: string }[]
  pendingPolicy: {
    note: string
    minAmountPending: true
    feePolicyPending: true
    autoPayoutPending: true
  }
  payoutGapNote: string
  audit: WithdrawalAudit[]
  mockOnly: true
}

export interface WithdrawalDetail {
  application: WithdrawalApplication
  audit: WithdrawalAudit[]
  payoutGapNote: string
  balanceNote: string
}

export type WithdrawalMutation =
  | {
      action: 'approve'
      withdrawalId: string
      version: number
      reason: string
      idempotencyKey: string
    }
  | {
      action: 'reject'
      withdrawalId: string
      version: number
      reason: string
      idempotencyKey: string
    }
  | {
      action: 'register-receipt'
      withdrawalId: string
      version: number
      receipt: 'SUCCESS' | 'FAILED'
      voucherUrl?: string
      reason: string
      idempotencyKey: string
    }

export type WithdrawalMutationResult =
  | { action: 'approve' | 'reject'; application: WithdrawalApplication; mockOnly: true }
  | {
      action: 'register-receipt'
      application: WithdrawalApplication
      mockOnly: true
    }

export class WithdrawalError extends Error {
  constructor(
    public code:
      | 'FORBIDDEN'
      | 'NOT_FOUND'
      | 'INVALID_INPUT'
      | 'INVALID_STATE'
      | 'VERSION_CONFLICT'
      | 'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT',
    message: string,
  ) {
    super(message)
    this.name = 'WithdrawalError'
  }
}
